items.title: Patagonia blurs the line between secondhand and new clothing
items.summary: Outdoor apparel retailer Patagonia will no longer maintain a separate website to represent the used clothing in the Worn Wear collection, launched nine years ago.

items.title: edie Energy & Tech Awards 2026: Winners unveiled at inaugural awards ceremony
items.summary: Sky, Octopus Energy and HIVED are among the winners of this year’s edie Energy & Tech Awards, who were announced at a glittering ceremony in central London on Friday (16 October).

items.title: COP17 on biodiversity: Everything you need to know
items.summary: The 17th Conference of the Parties (COP17) to the Convention on Biological Diversity commences next week.

items.title: COP17: Which countries have released new pledges to tackle nature loss?
items.summary: Some 58% of countries have met a UN call to submit new pledges on addressing nature loss – two years after the original deadline – according to Carbon Brief analysis.

items.title: 2026「台灣國際淨零永續展」與「台灣國際智慧能源週」圓滿落幕 亞太永續影響力平台 雙展展現科技與永續並進新局
items.summary: 最新商情 亞洲 2026/10/17 2026年台灣國際水週圓滿落幕 吸引48國買主參與 創新水科技與PFAS治理深化跨產業合作 由外貿協會主辦的「2026 年台灣國際水週（Taiwan International Water Week, TIWW）」昨（16）日圓滿落幕。

items.title: EU Greenwashing Rules Take Effect With Fines Exceeding 4% of Turnover
items.summary: Brussels has introduced stricter consumer protection rules targeting corporate greenwashing, exposing businesses to substantial financial penalties for misleading environmental claims.

items.title: Sustainability Reporting Expands Directors’ ESG Duties, ECGI Study Finds
items.summary: Mandatory sustainability reporting is changing what corporate directors must oversee, even where company law has not introduced new ESG obligations.

items.title: The 24-Hour Eco-Routine: How Green Founders Seamlessly Blend Sustainable Living from Home to Office
items.summary: For the modern small business owner, sustainability isn’t a corporate risk checklist—it’s a lifestyle. You don’t leave your values on your kitchen counter when you head out the door in the morning.

items.title: France, Germany Near Deal to Ease EU 2035 Car Emissions Targets
items.summary: France and Germany are nearing an agreement to ease the European Union’s 2035 vehicle emissions requirements while expanding preferential market access for Britain.

items.title: American Electric Power to Invest $4 Billion in Google Fuel Cell Project
items.summary: American Electric Power (AEP) plans to invest approximately $4 billion in a major fuel cell project near Cheyenne, Wyoming, to supply electricity to Google’s expanding data center operations.
